title: Final velocity after collision
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute v₀ = 5 m/s for part (1).

title: Normal force expression
description: Essential: The student must derive the linear relationship F_N = 0.1h - 0.14 N (for h ≥ 1.2 m) for part (2).

title: Range of x for h intervals
description: Essential: The student must provide both correct intervals for x in part (3): 2.6 m < x ≤ 3 m for 0.9 < h < 1.2 m, and (3 + √3/5) m ≤ x ≤ (3.6 + √3/5) m for 1.2 m ≤ h ≤ 1.65 m.

title: Elastic collision setup
description: Important: The student must apply both momentum and kinetic energy conservation correctly for the elastic collision.

title: Energy-work analysis on CD
description: Important: The student must use the work-energy theorem with friction to find stopping distances on segment CD for different scenarios.

title: Condition to reach point E
description: Important: The student must identify the minimum height h₁ = 1.2 m required for block a to reach the highest point E of the pipe.

title: Force balance at highest point
description: Important: The student must apply Newton's second law at point E, relating normal force, weight, and centripetal force.

title: Projectile motion from E
description: Optional: The student may calculate the time of fall from E to FG and the corresponding horizontal displacement.

title: Sign/direction error for F_N
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly states the direction of the normal force (should be downward at the top if needed) or mishandles signs in the force equation.

title: Friction work miscalculation
description: Pitfall: The student uses an incorrect friction force or distance when applying the work-energy theorem on MN/CD.
